market_name: Will 6 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the market probability move is sustained or a fat-finger/thin-liquidity spike; cross-check 2Y and 10Y yields for corroborating downward move.
time_plan.1h: Confirm rate futures (SOFR/Fed funds futures) are repricing dovishly; if yields are flat, downgrade signal.
time_plan.2h: Look for any macro headline (labor, credit, geopolitical shock) explaining the dovish shift and whether it is already public.
time_plan.6h: Re-assess TLT move vs. expected; watch for reversal if move was noise. Compare to MOVE index for rate vol.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate realized TLT return vs. 80bps estimate; note whether dovish repricing held into the close of the window.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 6 Fed cuts in 2026 signals a much more dovish/easing path than currently priced — likely reflecting recession or emergency-cut expectations. Aggressive easing pulls the entire yield curve lower, and long-duration Treasuries rally hardest as terminal-rate expectations fall. TLT is the most liquid, high-duration expression of this repricing.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Verify the market move is genuine and check DXY spot for immediate reaction.
time_plan.1h: Compare US front-end yields to EUR/JPY rate expectations; if global central banks also expected to cut, USD effect mutes.
time_plan.2h: Assess whether risk sentiment is risk-off (safe-haven USD bid could offset the rate-differential drag).
time_plan.6h: Re-check UUP vs. estimate and watch for reversal from haven flows.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate realized dollar move; flag if safe-haven dynamics dominated over rate differentials.

predictions.reasoning: A dovish repricing toward 6 cuts narrows US rate differentials versus other G10 central banks, typically weakening the dollar. UUP is a liquid dollar proxy. The effect is weaker and noisier than the rates channel because a recessionary dovish shock can also trigger safe-haven USD demand, muddying direction.

evidence_used: Market question implies an extreme dovish scenario of 6 (150bps) of cuts in 2026, well above a typical baseline path
Fed easing expectations map directly to Treasury yields (down) and the dollar (down) through rate-differential and duration channels
TLT and UUP are highly liquid, broad proxies for the rates and FX channels
uncertainty_notes: The 700bps tradability threshold is far above realistic 12h moves for these liquid macro proxies, so neither is 'tradable' under the stated bar
A move in this market may already reflect public data (jobs report, CPI, Fed speak) rather than leaked information
6 cuts is an extreme tail; probability can move on thin liquidity without genuine information content
Recessionary dovishness can produce safe-haven USD strength, reversing the FX call

llm_justification.summary: The market prices the probability of an unusually dovish 2026 Fed path (6 cuts / 150bps). A sharp increase in that probability would imply markets expecting aggressive easing, likely recession- or emergency-driven. The cleanest public-market implications are lower Treasury yields (TLT up) via duration/terminal-rate repricing and a weaker dollar (UUP down) via narrowing rate differentials, though the dollar channel is muddied by potential safe-haven flows. Both are modest, sub-threshold moves over 12h, so neither is tradable under the 700bps bar; this is a low-to-moderate-confidence macro mapping.
key_assumptions: A rise in the market's implied probability reflects genuine dovish repricing, not noise
US rates and dollar respond conventionally to easing expectations
No offsetting safe-haven distortion dominates the FX channel
failure_modes: The probability move is thin-liquidity noise in a low-volume tail market and mean-reverts quickly
The dovish shift is already fully public (post-CPI/jobs/Fed-speak) and priced into TLT and UUP
A recessionary dovish shock triggers safe-haven USD buying, reversing the dollar prediction
12h magnitudes are far below the 700bps tradability threshold, so signal is informational only
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
